stage: Prospective task-type preservation on two MixEval splits
sample: Each full split sorted bySHA256(UTF8 canonicalJSON sort_keys=True ensure_ascii=False separators comma/colon); tie originalindex; firstmin(100,N). No substitutions.
hypothesis: Structural-field availability does not preserve task type: the free_form split is routed through choice generation and remains instruction-incompatible after question-symbol binding alone. Matching task/output contract removes that mismatch. The multiple_choice split is a same-schema positive control after binding; allow counterexamples.
repair: bind_only substitutes mapped {prompt} to canonical {question}. bind_and_type additionally changes free_form route to key2_q_ma, removes {choices_text}, and replaces the fixed MC instruction with Answer the question in free text. Multiple-choice config remains key3_q_choices_a; split override is explicit diagnosticcontrol.
reference_semantics: free-form target list holds accepted text references; single-choice target list contains zero-based option index. Do not turn free-form targets into answer positions. Record unknown/ambiguous types without removing selected rows.
measures: source options preservation and target availability

predictions.free_form_bind_only: question binding repaired but type mismatch/MC instruction retained
predictions.free_form_bind_and_type: bound question with freeformroute and freeforminstruction
predictions.multiple_choice_bind_only: question binding repaired and options preserved; record reference anomalies if any

unknown_policy: Preserve exceptions, nonempty/null values, unsupported references and every selectedrow. No score or accuracy is computed; no model calls. Fix no scientific implementation after observing outcomes.
exposure: Gallery metadata and official documents inspected before protocol; one viewer/search example may have been displayed. No full source rows acquired in this stage. Earlier project used overlapping constituent benchmarks; no claim of new independent semantic question families or globally blind exposure.
scope: Exact native data-only methods under AST dependency scaffold and local recording sink; not native installed engine, models, tokenizer, official grading or external impact.
